subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: For strict delivery sanitization when a model emits `<think>private<final>answer</final>` without `</think>`, should OpenClaw recover only the final body, drop the payload, or keep the current post-`<think>` recovery?
rationale: This decides a security boundary between avoiding blank replies and preventing hidden reasoning from reaching external channel recipients; automation should not choose the permanent fallback semantics alone.

options.title: Recover final body only
options.body: Treat a valid `<final>` opener as the visible-answer boundary before unclosed reasoning fallback, preserving the answer while dropping private reasoning.

options.title: Fail closed on malformed reasoning
options.body: Drop the whole malformed payload when strict mode cannot prove a safe visible boundary, prioritizing privacy over answer recovery.

options.title: Keep current fallback
options.body: Continue recovering all text after the unclosed reasoning opener, accepting the hidden-reasoning leak risk for malformed providers.

recommendation.title: Recover final body only
recommendation.body: Treat a valid `<final>` opener as the visible-answer boundary before unclosed reasoning fallback, preserving the answer while dropping private reasoning.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on the shared reasoning/final-tag sanitizer behavior that steipete most directly shaped in recent merged history.
